info.name: FM-BE API Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive API test collection for the Facility Management Backend.

Suites execute in order — each suite depends on data created by previous suites.

**Execution Order:**
1. 00-Smoke — Health check
2. 01-Auth — Login, get tokens
3. 02-Users — Admin CRUD
4. 03-Employees — Employee onboarding
5. 04-Sites — Site + geofence setup
6. 05-Shifts — Shift scheduling
7. 06-Attendance — Punch in/out flow
8. 07-Location — Live location tracking
9. 08-SiteUpdates — Field reports
10. 09-Payroll — Salary + payroll run
11. 10-Notifications — Push notification flow
12. 11-Media — Presigned URL upload
13. 12-Admin — Audit logs, stats, export
14. 99-Cleanup — Teardown test data
